title: UPSC Civil Services
kicker: Government / Competitive · IAS, IPS, IFS and more

value.body: The Civil Services Examination (CSE), conducted by UPSC, recruits for the IAS, IPS, Indian Foreign Service and other Group A and Group B central services. It has three stages — Preliminary (objective), Main (written, essay-type) and a Personality Test (interview) — and one full cycle takes about a year.

items.label: Recommended for appointment
items.note: Final result, April 2025; 114 more later from the reserve list

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree in any discipline is required (final-year students can sit the Prelims). The general-category age range is 21–32, with relaxations for reserved categories and a limit on the number of attempts for some categories. After Class 12, students first complete a degree, and many begin reading for the exam during it.

value.title: At a glance
items: Very few candidates are selected relative to the number who apply, and many take several attempts.
The graduation subject does not restrict you; an optional subject is chosen for the Main exam.
Service and cadre allocation depend on final rank and stated preferences.
Preparation can take years, so a parallel career or fallback plan is common.
